en.heading: What I work on
en.intro: After post-training, we usually take three things on trust: that a benchmark score reflects the skill it is named after, that a probe reads the concept it is named after, and that an improvement comes from the training itself. My work checks each of these.

themes.title: Evaluation validity and leakage control
themes.body: Checking whether a benchmark score really measures the ability it claims to, rather than quirks of the scoring method, information leaking from the future, or the way the test set was built.

themes.title: Mechanistic interpretability
themes.body: Checking whether a probe or steering direction really captures the concept it is named after, or just picks up simpler signals such as word overlap or random noise.

themes.title: Alignment and safety
themes.body: Working out which behaviours post-training really changes, which only appear to change, and what evidence can tell the two apart.

en.outro: The five accepted papers above are all on the evaluation side. My work on training itself is still small-scale: fewer than 200 preference pairs per adapter, one algorithm, one A100 GPU. Taking that part to full research scale is what I want to do in a PhD.

zh.heading: 我在做什么
zh.intro: 后训练之后，我们通常默认三件事：基准分数反映的就是它所对应的能力；探针读出的就是它所对应的概念；性能提升确实来自训练本身。我的工作就是逐一检验这三点。

themes.title: 评测效度与泄漏控制
themes.body: 检验一个评测分数是否真的反映了它声称的能力，而不是打分方法的副作用、来自未来的信息泄漏，或测试集本身的构造方式。

themes.title: 机制可解释性
themes.body: 检验探针或引导方向是否真的捕捉到了它所对应的概念，还是只在利用词语重叠、随机噪声这类更简单的信号。

themes.title: 对齐与安全
themes.body: 弄清后训练真正改变了模型的哪些行为，哪些只是看起来改变了，以及用什么证据区分两者。

zh.outro: 上面五篇已录用论文都属于评测方向。训练方面的工作目前规模还小：每个适配器不到 200 个偏好对、一种算法、一张 A100。在博士阶段把这部分做到完整的研究规模，是我的目标。
